prompts.name: Body_Base
prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the attached original Sulien character illustration. Create one Live2D component texture named Body_Base. Preserve the original 1024x1536 full canvas, exact framing, pose, proportions, pixel positions, colors, and illustration style. Keep the entire hoodie, both hands/arms, trousers, shoes, and visible neck below the chin in their original locations. Remove the entire head/face and ALL hair; those areas become truly transparent. Reconstruct only the very small hoodie/neck areas occluded by hair, with matching fabric/skin, to allow slight hair sway. All background and removed components must be transparent, no glow or checkerboard painted in. Do not recenter, zoom, crop, pose-change, or redraw retained clothing details. No text or labels. This is a registration-locked transparent layer for later assembly, not a new character.

prompts.name: Face_Base
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / Live2D component extraction. Edit target: the attached original Sulien illustration, 1024x1536. Output the same FULL 1024x1536 transparent canvas. Lock registration: every retained pixel/feature must remain at its original coordinates, original scale, original pose; DO NOT zoom, center the extracted component, crop canvas, or change camera/framing. Preserve character identity and painterly anime linework, slate hair, pale skin, existing colors and lighting. Everything except the requested component must have true alpha transparency. No labels, checkerboard, glow, shadow backdrop, or additional character.
Component: Face_Base. Extract ONLY the bare face, both ears, and neck. Keep exact original face/jaw/ear/neck contours and tilt. Remove ALL hair, eyelashes/eyeballs, eyebrows, and lips/mouth mark. Seamlessly fill removed eyes/brows/mouth with matching skin so these features can be separate overlay layers. Reconstruct hidden forehead and skin behind hair for small motions; retain nose and original gentle facial shading. Extend neck slightly under hoodie. No clothing, hands, hair or eye features remain.

prompts.name: Face_Base_v2
prompts.prompt: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET (bare face part). Image 2 is ONLY a spatial registration reference. Correct ONLY scale and position of image 1: shrink the entire face-and-neck component to 32 percent of its CURRENT size, and place it near the top of the unchanged 1024x1536 canvas. The solid face component's upper-left should be around (408,51); ears should match reference image 2 near (415,160) and (555,148), nose near (484,178), chin near (489,225). Allow forehead to extend behind the future bangs. Keep the exact illustration, skin, ears, nose and neck from image 1; no eyes, brows, lips, hair or clothing. Most of the canvas, especially below y330, MUST be empty transparent. DO NOT recenter, enlarge to fill canvas, crop canvas, or redraw into a new large head. This is a tiny registered face layer to assemble on the full-body reference.

prompts.name: Eye_ViewerLeft
prompts.prompt:

Output unchanged 1024x1536 FULL CANVAS with true alpha transparency everywhere else. The feature is TINY near the TOP of this huge canvas, matching its original coordinates; leave the rest empty. Do not recenter, enlarge, fill the canvas, crop canvas, add labels, skin patches, background glow, head silhouette, or a new portrait. Preserve slate-gray eye color, fine anime linework, lighting, and original identity.
Component: Eye_ViewerLeft. ONLY the viewer-left eye (character's right eye), including the white of the eye, iris/pupil, original upper/lower lashes and subtle lid edge. Original approximate bounds x420..477, y128..167. No eyebrow or other eye. It must remain a tiny roughly 50px-wide eye in this location on the full transparent canvas.
